text_block_list.text:
While walking around to clear my head from 
paperwork after school, two Uma Musume 
called out to me――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Pardon me! Could you please 
listen to this girl sing?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I have a singing test tomorrow! So I 
wanted to practice singing in front of 
someone!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I can't really sing well in front 
of everyone... so...
choice_data_list: As long as it's just that, sure.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Waaah!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful! I'll be cheering for 
you, so do your best!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! All right, h-here I go!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm-hm... hmmmnnn...

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Uu... it really is embarrassing, after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll sing with you! That way, the 
embarrassment is cut in half, right!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm-hmmm♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Let's get moving! It's a festival 
song, so let's hype it up--!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Got it...! I'll give it a try!

As the girl moved along with the song, her 
smile grew wider and her voice grew 
louder!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Looking good! Put some power into 
your core for the finish...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaahnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Haaahnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! You sang with such a loud voice! 
How did it feel singing!?

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
That felt so good! All my embarrassment 
just flew right out the window!!
choice_data_list:
All that's left is to prepare for the main 
event!

All that's left is to get ready for the 
real thing!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
That felt so good! All my embarrassment 
just flew right out the window!!
choice_data_list:
All that's left is to prepare for the main 
event!

All that's left is to get ready for the 
real thing!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Singing next to you gave me total 
chills too!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Kita-chan! I can't wait for the 
real thing! I've never felt like this 
before!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Let's keep this momentum going and 
knock it out of the park for real!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We gotta make sure we take proper 
care of our throats for the main event, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I see, stuff like that matters too! 
Kita-chan, you sure know a lot!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ If it's anything I can help with, 
I'm always here for you!
